name: agent-workflow
description: Set up or audit a two-agent development workflow: a head (planner) on a strong model and an executor on a cheaper or local model, talking through files in the repo. Generates project-specific role skills, a handoff folder (tasks, reports, NOTES, ROADMAP), capacity-tuned task formats, and scripts that check report evidence, log provenance, leaked secrets, process notes in product files, and undefined names in changed lines, plus a start-of-session brief that shortens large state files. Skill text is in Indonesian; generated files follow the user's language.
